digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira - Jira family shared layer extraction
propositions: Identity convention, probe classifier, and link vocabulary logic are Jira-family-general rather than Cloud-specific and must be extracted from adapters/jira/ to a new adapters/jira_family/ package with public contracts for reuse by other Jira-variant adapters.

Value maps for local-to-Jira status and priority translation exist as duplicates in jira_fields.py and outbound_fields.py with drift (deleted key missing), requiring consolidation into a single jira_family/ definition that both ACLI transport and backend.py consume.

jira_fields.py cannot relocate wholesale because it imports from location-pinned modules adf.py and comment_limits.py; instead symbols split by symbol with _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment receiving vendor dependencies as injected contract objects rather than imports.

ACLI-facing sanitizers and constants must maintain their underscore-prefixed module-local names through aliased imports so __all__ and ~8 call sites remain byte-identical while underlying imports re-point to jira_family/.

The deleted status key previously mapped to invalid Jira name 'Deleted' via .title() fallback; unified map adopts deleted→Done matching outbound_fields.py and config.py, representing a declared behavior fix for the ACLI path.

Location-pinned modules adf.py, comment_limits.py, and outbound_fields.py remain at their paths and are shared by dependency inversion rather than relocation, with pinned imports using absolute paths to survive spec_from_file_location synthetic loading with no package context.
